Carrier.carrier_store.statement:
carrier_store
     : Storage.state ?H -> nat -> nat -> nat -> option (Storage.state ?H)
where
?H : [ |- Type]

Carrier.metadata_ok_spec.statement:
metadata_ok_spec
     : forall n : nat,
       metadata_ok n = true <->
       BinInt.Z.le BinNums.Z0 (BinInt.Z.of_nat n) /\
       BinInt.Z.lt (BinInt.Z.of_nat n)
         (BinInt.Z.pow (BinNums.Zpos (BinNums.xO BinNums.xH))
            (BinNums.Zpos
               (BinNums.xO
                  (BinNums.xO
                     (BinNums.xO
                        (BinNums.xO (BinNums.xO (BinNums.xO BinNums.xH))))))))

Carrier.carrier_pointer.statement:
carrier_pointer
     : forall (n : nat) (r : Interface.reference),
       metadata_ok n = true ->
       array_to_slice (Storage.RefValue r) n = Some (Storage.SliceValue r n)

Carrier.raw_is_not_array_reference.statement:
raw_is_not_array_reference
     : forall (n : nat) (r : Interface.reference),
       array_to_slice (Storage.RawValue r) n = None

Carrier.slice_is_not_array_reference.statement:
slice_is_not_array_reference
     : forall (n : nat) (r : Interface.reference) (k : nat),
       array_to_slice (Storage.SliceValue r k) n = None

Carrier.unrepresentable_rejected.statement:
unrepresentable_rejected
     : forall (n : nat) (v : Storage.value),
       metadata_ok n = false -> array_to_slice v n = None

Carrier.carrier_output.statement:
carrier_output
     : forall (n : nat) (v out : Storage.value),
       array_to_slice v n = Some out ->
       exists r : Interface.reference,
         v = Storage.RefValue r /\
         out = Storage.SliceValue r n /\ metadata_ok n = true

Carrier.carrier_progress.statement:
carrier_progress
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat)
         (r : Interface.reference),
       src <> dst ->
       Storage.locals s src =
       Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.RefValue r))) ->
       Storage.locals s dst = Some (Storage.Immediate Storage.Uninit) ->
       metadata_ok n = true ->
       carrier_store s src dst n =
       Some
         (Storage.set_local s dst
            (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r n))))

Carrier.carrier_characterization.statement:
carrier_characterization
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       exists r : Interface.reference,
         src <> dst /\
         Storage.locals s src =
         Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.RefValue r))) /\
         Storage.locals s dst = Some (Storage.Immediate Storage.Uninit) /\
         metadata_ok n = true /\
         t =
         Storage.set_local s dst
           (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r n)))

Carrier.carrier_destination.statement:
carrier_destination
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       exists r : Interface.reference,
         Storage.locals s src =
         Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.RefValue r))) /\
         Storage.locals t dst =
         Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r n)))

Carrier.carrier_other_local.statement:
carrier_other_local
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n k : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       k <> dst -> Storage.locals t k = Storage.locals s k

Carrier.carrier_source_preserved.statement:
carrier_source_preserved
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       Storage.locals t src = Storage.locals s src

Carrier.carrier_anchors.statement:
carrier_anchors
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       Storage.anchors t = Storage.anchors s

Carrier.carrier_all_cells.statement:
carrier_all_cells
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       forall a : Storage.location,
       Storage.physical_cells t a = Storage.physical_cells s a

Carrier.carrier_pending_control.statement:
carrier_pending_control
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       carrier_store s src dst n = Some t ->
       Storage.pc t = Storage.pc s /\
       Storage.private_stack t = Storage.private_stack s /\
       Storage.fresh_stack t = Storage.fresh_stack s /\
       Storage.storage_trace t = Storage.storage_trace s /\
       Storage.incoming_history t = Storage.incoming_history s

Carrier.same_local_rejected.statement:
same_local_rejected
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (src n : nat),
       carrier_store s src src n = None

Carrier.uninitialized_source_rejected.statement:
uninitialized_source_rejected
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       Storage.locals s src = Some (Storage.Immediate Storage.Uninit) ->
       carrier_store s src dst n = None

Carrier.dead_destination_rejected.statement:
dead_destination_rejected
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (src dst n : nat),
       Storage.locals s dst = Some Storage.Dead ->
       carrier_store s src dst n = None

Carrier.ten_byte_carrier.statement:
ten_byte_carrier
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (src dst : nat)
         (r : Interface.reference),
       src <> dst ->
       Storage.locals s src =
       Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.RefValue r))) ->
       Storage.locals s dst = Some (Storage.Immediate Storage.Uninit) ->
       carrier_store s src dst 10 =
       Some
         (Storage.set_local s dst
            (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r 10))))

Carrier.byte128_carrier.statement:
byte128_carrier
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (src dst : nat)
         (r : Interface.reference),
       src <> dst ->
       Storage.locals s src =
       Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.RefValue r))) ->
       Storage.locals s dst = Some (Storage.Immediate Storage.Uninit) ->
       carrier_store s src dst 128 =
       Some
         (Storage.set_local s dst
            (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r 128))))

Carrier.changed_tag_same_subobject.statement:
changed_tag_same_subobject
     : forall r : Interface.reference,
       Interface.same_subobject r (changed_tag r)

Carrier.changed_tag_same_address.statement:
changed_tag_same_address
     : forall (r : Interface.reference) (j : nat),
       Interface.ref_address (changed_tag r) j = Interface.ref_address r j

Carrier.changed_tag_distinct.statement:
changed_tag_distinct
     : forall r : Interface.reference, changed_tag r <> r

Root.root_carrier_progress.statement:
root_carrier_progress
     : forall (H : Type) (s : Storage.state H) (r : Interface.reference),
       Storage.locals s 4 =
       Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.RefValue r))) ->
       Storage.locals s 3 = Some (Storage.Immediate Storage.Uninit) ->
       carrier_store s 4 3 128 =
       Some
         (Storage.set_local s 3
            (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r 128))))

Root.root_still_pending.statement:
root_still_pending
     : forall (H : Type) (s t : Storage.state H),
       Storage.current_event s = root_unsize_site ->
       carrier_store s 4 3 128 = Some t ->
       Storage.current_event t = root_unsize_site

Root.source_dead_does_not_discard_payloa.statement:
source_dead_does_not_discard_payload
     : forall (H : Type) (s t u : Storage.state H),
       carrier_store s 4 3 128 = Some t ->
       Storage.storage_dead t 4 = Some u ->
       exists r : Interface.reference,
         Storage.locals u 3 =
         Some (Storage.Immediate (Storage.Init (Storage.SliceValue r 128))) /\
         Storage.locals u 4 = Some Storage.Dead /\
         Storage.anchors u = Storage.anchors s
